```sql
WITH improvements AS (
    SELECT
        b."Child ID",
        b."Child Name",
        b."Gender",
        b."Location",
        b."Coach",
        b."Age",
        b."Sit Ups" AS "Baseline Sit Ups",
        e."Sit Ups" AS "Endline Sit Ups",
        NULLIF(e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups", 0) AS "Sit Up Improvement"
    FROM
        "sportathon_baseline" b
    JOIN
        "sportathon_endline" e ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(b."Child ID")), lower(trim(e."Child ID"))) >= 0.9
    WHERE
        b."Gender" IN ('F', 'M')
        AND b."Location" IN ('Chembur', 'Dharavi', 'Govandi', 'Kurla', 'Mankhurd', 'Wadala')
        AND e."Location" IN ('Chembur', 'Dharavi', 'Govandi', 'Kurla', 'Mankhurd', 'Wadala')
        AND b."Coach" IN ('Anjali Kamble', 'Deepak Rane', 'Fatima Shaikh', 'Irfan Sheikh', 'Kavita Pawar', 'Meena Chavan', 'Nasreen Ansari', 'Prakash Sawant', 'Ramesh Yadav', 'Sunita More', 'Suresh Gaikwad', 'Vikram Jadhav')
        AND e."Coach" IN ('Anjali Kamble', 'Deepak Rane', 'Fatima Shaikh', 'Irfan Sheikh', 'Kavita Pawar', 'Meena Chavan', 'Nasreen Ansari', 'Prakash Sawant', 'Ramesh Yadav', 'Sunita More', 'Suresh Gaikwad', 'Vikram Jadhav')
)
SELECT
    "Child ID",
    "Child Name",
    "Gender",
    "Location",
    "Coach",
    "Age",
    "Baseline Sit Ups",
    "Endline Sit Ups",
    "Sit Up Improvement"
FROM
    improvements
ORDER BY
    "Sit Up Improvement" DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
